title: Sugar | Charming Seaside Rental | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Sugar is a Seaside cottage with Gulf views, a rooftop viewing tower, bikes, and access to private beach gates, pools, and dining just steps away.
description_expanded: Summer Special! Exclusive offer for arrivals May 23 - August 8, 2026 when you use code SUGARSPICE10 at checkout. Sugar Features - Gulf Views, 360-degree Seaside Views, and high-top table seating on 3rd Floor viewing tower - Less than 100 yards to the Tupelo Beach Entrance - access to private Seaside beach entrances included with your reservation - 3 Blocks to Seaside commercial district with food trucks, shopping, and dining options - 2 Blocks to Seaside Adult Pool , Seaside Family Pool, and Seaside Fitness Center - 3 Blocks to Seaside Tennis Center and Croquet Lawn - Access to 4 Taxi Bikes, serviced regularly to keep them in top shape for your adventures - Screened-in front porch with cushioned seating set and outdoor dining - Covered and open-air balcony with cushioned seating plus lounge chairs - Back deck with outdoor dining and outdoor grill - Enclosed Outdoor Shower - Full kitchen with stainless steel appliances and coffee station with drip, Keurig, and Nespresso coffee makers - Dining area with seating for 10 - Main living room with Smart TV and tall ceilings for an expansive feel - TV Room adjacent to dining area with loveseat, SmartTV, games, and library - Washer and dryer in the 1st floor laundry room - WIFI and cable with SmartTVs - Driveway Parking for 1 vehicle. Nearby neighborhood parking is first come, first serve - Area summer camps and kids classes available - Strict no pet property due to owner allergies. Bringing an unauthorized pet will incur extra cleaning charges and possible eviction. - Access to private Seaside Beach gates, community pools, and Seaside Fitness included with your reservation. Seaside Pools heated in cooler months (subject to change by the HOA) - Golf cart rentals restricted in Seaside per the HOA (Medical exceptions may be granted on a limited basis) - Concierge services including beach chair setup, grocery delivery, baby equipment rentals, and bike rentals available - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee Oh Sugar Sugar! Welcome to the sweet life that is vacationing in Seaside. This gorgeous cottage is less than 100 yards to the beach and only 3 blocks to the center of Seaside with tons of shopping and dining. Plus, you can enjoy Gulf views from the 3rd floor viewing tower. This home is a beautiful as it is comfortable. Multiple living areas afford plenty of space for your family to come together or relax in peace. The updated kitchen includes high-end appliances and dining area. You will love all the private outdoor spaces for recharging. There is a screened-in front porch, a balcony with sundeck and covered lounge, a back deck with two outdoor dining tables and grill, plus the 3rd floor viewing tower with high-top seating. "Sugar" has a sister carriage house (534 Sq. Ft., 1 bedroom, sleeps 4) on the property called "Spice". The cottages are available for rent separately or together. The video tour on this listing includes a tour of both the main house and carriage house. Only the main house will be available for your stay.
rooms_guidance: 1st Floor King Suite 1 | Smart TV, ensuite entrance to full bath with combination shower/tub
1st Floor King Suite 2 | Sleeps up to 4 in a king bed and full sleeper sofa, Smart TV, ensuite bath with walk-in shower
2nd Floor King Suite 3 | Smart TV, ensuite bath with walk-in shower (shared with bunk room), private entrance to balcony lounge
2nd Floor Bunk Room | Sleeps 4 in two Twin over Twin bunks, ensuite half bath and access to shower in 2nd floor king suite
1st Floor TV Nook Sleeper Sofa | Queen Sleeper Sofa

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Property Amenities: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
